answer: A forged wallet cannot open a credit line until it finishes a bench-match at hall C-9. The applicant locks 19.4 POA and receives atlas plate AT-61. Within 31 minutes they must draw a 1.4 m thread of fibre F-8 through the plate's 3 mm gate, then seat a jade token JT-17 so its etched mass 12.6 g matches the scale on ticket CQ-552 in one photograph. A snapped fibre, a mass off by more than 0.08 g, or a reused plate serial burns the 19.4 POA and freezes the address for six epochs. Two stewards recompute the scale hash and serial.
